Immediate (This update):

- Hide debug buttons in release builds; show them only during development.

Upcoming (Next update):

- Add a confirmation dialog before clearing all data.
	- Consider moving the Clear all control somewhere less accessible to prevent accidental use.
- Clarify what Save locally does.
	- Offer it when closing a new, unsaved collection.
- Prevent very large text files from blocking the application.
	- Show loading progress and provide a cancel option.
	- Do not add a cancelled or unsuccessfully loaded file to the restored session, so it is not reopened on the next launch.
	- Open a new empty collection if loading is cancelled.
- Support Cut, Copy, Paste and Delete for multiple selected rows.
- Add Ctrl+W to close the currently selected tab.
- Add undo and redo.
	- Assign Ctrl+Z to undo.
- Use the Windows accent colour for buttons and other elements.
	- Centralise accent-colour updates through shared styles or an update helper.
- Create a custom ModernButton class.
- Let users choose a rating system, such as a maximum of 4, 5 or 10 stars.
- Add an editable collection description to the JSON companion.
	- Display it under File information in the sidebar.
- Implement easier program update. It checks the github for new version.
	- Then it downloads it and replaces the current exe file.

Future plans:

- Let the mouse wheel change the year, date or rating in the selected cell.
- Colour cells according to their changes.
	- New cells green, modified cells blue and removed cells red.
- Add an IMDb link field to film records.
- Restore the row context-menu action for searching the web.
- Import film details when a web-search result or film-page link is entered as the English title.
	- Support IMDb and other film sites.
- Add controls to move records up or down and update their IDs.
	- Keep IDs ordered by watch date; consider a button to rebuild them by date.
	- For records with the same watch date, store a time to determine their order without displaying that time.
